sections.description: Russia is dropped as the named jurisdiction for patent exploitation and sales restrictions, the named tariff targets China, Mexico and Canada are dropped while tariffs move from recently announced to has imposed and/or announced, data localization laws and data transfer restrictions are added as protective policies, and rising is removed from conflict in the Middle East.

A.rationale: Criterion 2: named jurisdictions (Russia, China, Mexico, Canada) are dropped, and criteria 1 and 3 also apply because a new exposure (data localization and transfer restrictions) is added and tariffs move from announced to imposed.

B.rationale: criterion 3 (tariffs go from announced to has imposed, and rising is dropped from the Middle East conflict) plus criterion 2 (Russia, China, Mexico and Canada are dropped as named jurisdictions) plus criterion 1 (data localization and data transfer restrictions are a newly disclosed exposure).

sections.description: The Orthopaedics separation announced in October 2025, targeted for completion 18 to 24 months after announcement, may be delayed or not completed on the contemplated terms because it depends on works council consultations, final Board approval and regulatory approvals.

sections.current_heading: The costs to complete the planned separation will be significant. In addition, the Company may be unable to achieve some of the strategic and financial benefits that it expects to achieve from the planned separation of the Company's Orthopaedics business
sections.description: The planned Orthopaedics separation will involve significant costs, and the Company may not achieve its expected strategic and financial benefits because they rest on assumptions that may prove incorrect.

sections.current_heading: Following the planned separation, the price of shares of the Company's common stock may fluctuate significantly
sections.description: The Company cannot predict the separation's effect on its common stock price, which may fall below its pre-separation value and be more volatile around the time of the separation.

sections.description: Increasing use of and reliance on third parties is added as a driver of cybersecurity risk, and the AI risk driver is widened from AI alone to AI and other emerging technology.

A.rationale: Criterion 1: a new dependency (reliance on third parties) is disclosed as increasing attack exposure, and criterion 3 applies because the scope of the technology risk widens to other emerging technology.

B.rationale: criterion 1 (third-party reliance is newly disclosed as a factor increasing breach risk) plus criterion 3 (scope of the technology risk widened beyond AI to other emerging technology).
